fix_1: Replaced linear similarity formula (clipped to 0 for outlier distances) with bounded exponential decay — high-amount matches were already correct, just displaying as 0%.
fix_2: Switched to a curated 8-feature similarity space (dropped hour/day_of_week/categorical codes) to reduce noise from features unrelated to fraud-pattern identity.
known_limitation: Card-testing fraud (6-row bursts on one device, ₹1-20 each) remains hard to cluster reliably even after the fix — the burst is only ~4% of all fraud cases (36/140), too sparse for FAISS to form a tight neighborhood. Documented as a data-density limitation, not re-patched further given this is a stretch feature.
